description: Container that sets the reading direction, left to right or reversed.

howToUse: Use it around content in languages written right to left, such as Arabic and Hebrew.
Set `dir="rtl"`: the refy components inside flip. In your own layout, use start and end instead of left and right.
alternatives: The whole app in one language: set `dir` on the `<html>` tag.

keyboard.action: Direction does not receive focus. Arrows inside it follow the reading direction.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.

props.description: Callback called when the value changes.
